text:
Jean-Pierre Slams Leavitt as “Deplorable” – Trump’s Press Sec Fires Back with Pure Fire Response! (Video)
America, if this exchange doesn’t expose the radical left’s desperation and hypocrisy while showcasing Trump’s team’s fire, nothing will—former White House press secretary Karine Jean-Pierre called current press secretary Karoline Leavitt “deplorable” on “The View,” reigniting the 2016 Clinton slur against Trump supporters.
The co-hosts played a clip of Leavitt’s blunt assessment: “The Democratic Party’s main constituency are made up of Hamas terrorists, illegal aliens, and violent criminals.” Jean-Pierre, clutching pearls, retorted, “Hearing that, it’s deplorable. And I’m using that word on purpose. Because they don’t seem to understand, this is the Trump White House, that they don’t work for just one man. They work for the American people.” She also criticized Leavitt’s viral “your mom” joke to a HuffPost reporter, calling it “online trolling” unfit for the role. “The White House press secretary is not about doing online trolling. It is an honor and a privilege to have that job and to speak on behalf of the most powerful person in the world. And there is a level of respect for the freedom of the press, even if you disagree with them.” Jean-Pierre, on a book tour to “fix a broken system,” claimed Leavitt’s words fuel divisiveness, not unity.
Video:
Leavitt didn’t back down. In a fiery response, she blasted Jean-Pierre: “Karine worked for the most incompetent president in history, so I guess she has a reason to be BITTER. But being BITTER will not sell you books.” She accused Jean-Pierre of being “one of the main culprits of the greatest cover up and scandal in American history,” lying daily about Biden’s incompetence. “She said this past week that Joe Biden would still be up for the job…she actually said this week as well on a podcast that Joe Biden did ‘more press engagements than President Trump currently does now.’ Any person across the aisle can tell you that is a bald-faced LIE.” Leavitt concluded, “I’m VERY proud to work for the greatest president in history.”
Conservatives cheer Leavitt’s truth bombs—Jean-Pierre’s “deplorable” jab backfired, exposing her bitterness. Trump’s team fights fire with fire, while the left whines about “unity” they never practice. This is why Trump’s winning—honesty over hypocrisy.
